title: inbox feed: sys_notification_receipt and sys_inbox_message have no index on created_at, so the badge's window reads sort the user's whole history every poll
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #35410 dev (os-dev-report 7010857170, PR #35519 Acceptance notes), read in the object definitions and not measured. L1-a named it as owed (ACCEPT 7011659709). It is a follow-up of the #34211 page-load work and is nested under #34211.
Reader: `domain:server` (the messaging objects' index declarations). Suggested grade: p3 (not a landing block at the 20-row window; the cost grows with a user's receipt history).
Dedupe: `notification receipt index created_at`, `inbox message index`, `sys_inbox_message index`. No open card.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；铃铛角标的两次读取在数据量大的账号上会变慢，加索引后保持稳定。
- 为什么做：页面加载提速时把已读状态的读取改成按时间取最新一批，这两张表还没有按用户和时间的索引。
- 出错会怎样：只影响查询速度，不影响数据；撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Facts (read at PR #35519, landing head `43ed4f99`)

- After #35519 the console's inbox feed reads `sys_inbox_message` filtered by `user_id`, newest first, top 20, and in parallel `sys_notification_receipt` filtered by `user_id` + `channel: inbox`, newest first, top 20. Both poll at the 10 s foreground cadence.
- `sys_notification_receipt` indexes `(notification_id, user_id, channel)` (unique) and `(user_id, state)`. `sys_inbox_message` declares none. Neither has `created_at` in an index, so each read sorts the user's rows.

## Ask

Add a `(user_id, channel, created_at)` index on `sys_notification_receipt` and a `(user_id, created_at)` index on `sys_inbox_message`. Measure the two reads' query plan or time before and after on a user with a large history (e.g. a few thousand receipts). Check whether adding an index is a metadata-protocol or Clause-② change for these system objects and declare it.

⛔ Not a claim.
